verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP integration lets users ask an LLM to surface themes and context from feedback, and Autopilot captures untracked feedback, showing some AI-driven insight surfacing, but there's no evidence of a fully automatic engine that proactively detects insights and links them to related feature ideas without a user query. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic (unprompted) insight detection, explicit feedback-to-idea linking logic, and independent validation of accuracy.
